_comment: Module 31 of link unit libgit2, `src/libgit2/proxy.c`: its files and the entities its modules.json record owns, as wavefront finds its dependency edges and schedules it. Paths are below the C root, c/; out_of_scope.items names the entities its files define or declare that other modules own, or that the scope excludes (deprecated or never defined in the configured build).
